content: वरीयस् {%a.%} .²1 Better, more excellent, preferable; आरादुपकारकेभ्यः सामवायिकान्यङ्गानि वरीयांसि भवन्ति <ls>ŚB. on MS. 10. 1. 23</ls>. .²2 Most excellent, very good; वरीयानन्योन्यप्रगुणगुणनिर्माणनिपुणः <ls>Māl. 1. 16</ls>. .²3 Larger, wider, more extensive (<ab>compar.</ab> of उरु <ab>q. v.</ab>). .²4 Extremely tender or younger. --{%m.%} <ab>N.</ab> of one of the Yogas. --{%n.%} <ab>Ved.</ab> Rest, repose.
